source_backbone: Royal Botanic Gardens Kew POWO/WCVP 2026, primary 2025 Polypogon exaratus and Agrostis monspeliensis combinations as indexed by POWO; 2006 World Grass Species Synonymy; published Flora Atlantica 1798
synonym_and_rank_caution: Historical varieties and subspecies of P. monspeliensis resolve across distinct accepted species P. maritimus, P. subspathaceus and P. exaratus; 2025 Agrostis monspeliensis is homotypic synonym, not second species. Named P. × adscendens and × Agropogon lutosus are separate accepted hybrids; no individual hybrid ancestry is inferred.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; all county and native-metrics flags unchanged
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — source-labelled only; no individual voucher or diagnostic anatomy certification
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no individual hybrid or introgression determination
install_decision: Retain existing canonical P. monspeliensis card; do not create alias or hybrid cards from these findings; no species edit, photos, lessons, county range, Pages, or installation.

decisions.subject: Polypogon monspeliensis (L.) Desf. (1798)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain as accepted Poaceae species, rank species, author (L.) Desf.
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts this name, Flora Atlantica 1:66 (1798).

decisions.subject: Alopecurus monspeliensis L. (1753)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as Linnaean basionym / homotypic synonym, not separate learner species
decisions.detail: Sp. Pl. 61 (1753), type-linked historical name.

decisions.subject: Agrostis monspeliensis (L.) Romero Zarco & L.Sáez (2025)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as 2025 homotypic synonym; do not automatically replace accepted Polypogon backbone
decisions.detail: POWO records a new generic combination while continuing to accept Polypogon monspeliensis.

decisions.subject: Polypogon monspeliensis var. capensis Steud. (1829)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted Polypogon monspeliensis
decisions.detail: POWO synonym, not separately accepted variety.

decisions.subject: Polypogon monspeliensis var. indicus Bhattacharya & S.K.Jain (1985)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted Polypogon monspeliensis
decisions.detail: POWO lists the variety as synonym of species.

decisions.subject: Polypogon monspeliensis var. paniceus (L.) Gray (1822)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted Polypogon monspeliensis
decisions.detail: POWO synonym; do not treat historical varietal rank as current acceptance.

decisions.subject: Polypogon monspeliensis var. interruptus Trin. (1836)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted Polypogon monspeliensis
decisions.detail: POWO synonym at species rank.

decisions.subject: Polypogon monspeliensis var. pallens Nees (1841)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted Polypogon monspeliensis
decisions.detail: POWO synonym at species rank.

decisions.subject: Polypogon maritimus Willd.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as separately accepted species from P. monspeliensis
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts both, despite older subspecies/variety combinations under P. monspeliensis.

decisions.subject: Polypogon subspathaceus Req.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as separately accepted species from P. monspeliensis
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts separately; old monspeliensis ranks map here.

decisions.subject: Polypogon exaratus (Trin.) P.M.Peterson, Soreng & Romasch. (2025)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve newly accepted species and basionym Agrostis exarata Trin.; do not map monolepis variety to P. monspeliensis
decisions.detail: POWO recognizes 2025 Polypogon combination and lists P. monspeliensis var. monolepis as synonym of P. exaratus.

decisions.subject: Polypogon viridis (Gouan) Breistr.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve separately accepted species; recognized hybrid parent
decisions.detail: POWO recognizes P. viridis separately from P. monspeliensis.

decisions.subject: Polypogon × adscendens Guss.
decisions.proposed_decision: Recognize accepted named hybrid P. monspeliensis × P. viridis, not synonym of either parent
decisions.detail: POWO accepted nothotaxon with documented hybrid formula.

decisions.subject: × Agropogon lutosus (Poir.) P.Fourn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Recognize accepted intergeneric hybrid Agrostis stolonifera × Polypogon monspeliensis; do not fold into P. monspeliensis
decisions.detail: POWO recognizes separate named hybrid with cross-genus formula.

decisions.subject: Auto-merge P. monspeliensis var. maritimus and subsp. maritimus into P. monspeliensis
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject; author-qualified historic ranks map to accepted Polypogon maritimus
decisions.detail: Historical placement under P. monspeliensis does not imply current species-level identity.

decisions.subject: Auto-merge P. monspeliensis var. subspathaceus and subsp. subspathaceus into P. monspeliensis
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject; both map to separately accepted Polypogon subspathaceus
decisions.detail: Two different infraspecific ranks resolve outside parent binomial.

decisions.subject: Auto-merge P. monspeliensis var. monolepis Torr. into P. monspeliensis
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject; POWO maps name to accepted Polypogon exaratus
decisions.detail: 2025 Polypogon exaratus combination replaces earlier Agrostis exarata accepted generic treatment.

decisions.subject: Create second learner species for Agrostis monspeliensis 2025 combination
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject duplicate canonical concept
decisions.detail: POWO records the combination as homotypic synonym, not accepted separate species.

decisions.subject: Individual source-labelled Polypogon monspeliensis learner photographs and specimens
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve individual identification HOLD pending diagnostic/voucher confirmation
decisions.detail: Taxonomy-only name evidence cannot authenticate existing images or determine look-alike specimens.

decisions.subject: Hybrid or introgressed ancestry of individual learner Polypogon plants
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve ancestry HOLD; do not assign named hybrid to any photographed plant
decisions.detail: Named hybrids exist but no same-individual specimen, morphology or genetic parentage verification is supplied.

decisions.subject: Unqualified historical Polypogon monspeliensis infraspecific labels without author/rank/voucher
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve original label and require author, rank, publication and voucher before synonym mapping
decisions.detail: Varietal combinations under same parent binomial map to multiple separately accepted species; a bare label is insufficient.
